thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: org=nightshade-labs - sustained QPS spike ~3.8x baseline, error rate creeping 5xx=2.1% and p95 latency > 2s. Paging on-call. See /incidents/7180054321 for context.

sara.ong: On it. joining bridge — starting triage. Can someone post impact to customers?

jamal: I see traffic origin from two IP blocks, heavy embedding requests. Token inflight up ~4x. No config change on our side.

lauren.m: Nightshade support reporting degraded UX for autocomplete features, several customers complaining. They requested temporary relief for org-nightshade.

kevin_ops: Going to check quota/rl rules. If we increase org quota or bump rate limit for nightshade, need approval from oncall+eng-sre. I can do a short-lived override (5-15m) if agreed.

nightshade-support: Confirming major customers A & B affected, A has a peak campaign live. They are asking for any lift to keep sessions alive.

jamal: Suggest we apply traffic shaping first: reduce max tokens and disable non-critical rerank route for that org to conserve tokens. If that fails, emergency org-level rate bump.

kevin_ops: I can apply a temporary quota delta via admin API. Command: ```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood-inference/internal/orgs/nightshade/overrides \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"delta_rps": 50, "expires_in_s": 900, "reason": "emergency spike - customer request"}'
```

sara.ong: Jamal and Kevin please coordinate. If we do a delta + feature-disable, ensure we have fallback to baseline if error rate rises. Set alert to auto-revert at expiry.

ops-bot: Action queued: create-override request received. ID=ovr-7180054321-1. Will apply after manual confirm.

kevin_ops: Applying now. ovrd id ovr-7180054321-1 -> delta_rps=50 expires=900s. Pushed to prod.

incident-bot: Override applied by kevin_ops. Metrics hook enabled.

jamal: Monitoring... p95 latency dropped from 2.1s -> 1.2s in 60s. 5xx stable at 0.9%. Token burn down as expected.

lauren.m: Nightshade confirms sessions restored. They asked about longer window — recommend follow-up with account team to discuss committed capacity or Dedicated.

sara.ong: I'm going to leave the override for 15m and then ramp down. I've set a canary check at +10m to evaluate rollback. If error climbs above 1.5% we'll revert immediately.

kevin_ops: Noted. Also disabled rerank route for org-nightshade: config change id cfg-7180054321-rr1.

nightshade-support: Thanks, engineers. They appreciate the quick fix. Can you send a short incident summary to them and the AM?

jamal: Will prepare a 1-paragraph summary and post after we confirm stability.

ops-bot: Override ovr-7180054321-1 will auto-expire at 7180055221 (900s). Canary evaluation scheduled at 7180054921.

incident-bot: Incident ongoing -> mitigation applied. Update required in 30m or on any status changes. :white_check_mark:
